caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a wallet or pouch, positioned centrally on an off-white background. The top section is open and displays an inner flap of solid green fabric, with rough, slightly frayed edges. The bottom section, which forms the body of the pouch, is decorated with an ornate, repeating pattern featuring intersecting diagonal lines in dark blue and yellow, forming a diamond lattice. Inside each diamond are stylized motifs composed of combinations of green, yellow, red, and white, resembling floral or geometric shapes. The object is rendered with a focus on texture and textile detail, emphasizing the woven and embroidered qualities of the fabric. There are faint rectangular markings on either side of the pouch, possibly indicating the outline of another object or frame once present. The overall composition centers the pouch, with ample empty space surrounding it.
title: Purse
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
